findings.body: The volume mount references `./deploy/mongo/kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py`, but that file does not exist in the repository at this commit. Docker Compose will fail to start with an error about a missing file. This must be resolved either by adding the script or by using an alternative approach that does not require an external file.
findings.title: Ensure the referenced script file exists in the repository

findings.body: The entrypoint invokes `python3`, but the standard MongoDB community-server image (8.2.12-ubi9) does not include Python. This will cause the container to fail with "exec: 'python3': executable file not found". The overlay is intended to make the database start, but it introduces a dependency that is not satisfied. Consider using a shell script or a statically compiled binary that does not require Python.
findings.title: Ensure Python is available in the base image or use a shell script

value.summary: This overlay introduces a kernel bypass configuration but references a non-existent script file and assumes Python is available in the MongoDB image, both of which prevent the overlay from working as intended.
